question: Estimate the number of independent paint dealers (small/medium) in a state like Karnataka.
idealClarificationQuestions: Paint dealers — retailers selling Asian Paints, Berger, Kansai Nerolac, Akzo Nobel, Indigo etc.? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of this, retailed through dealers (not direct contractor / project sales): ~70% = ₹5,250 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: avg ₹70 lakh (small dealers ₹25L, medium ₹1.5 Cr, large ₹4 Cr).

calculationFlow: India total paint market FY26: ~₹85,000 Cr; Karnataka ~₹7,500 Cr.
Of this, retailed through dealers (not direct contractor / project sales): ~70% = ₹5,250 Cr.
Per-dealer annual turnover: avg ₹70 lakh (small dealers ₹25L, medium ₹1.5 Cr, large ₹4 Cr).
